chapter.verse: Jesu khuadak a, sumpi kuang sungah amau' citpiak sumte a khia mihaute mu hi.
Leptona tang nih a khia mizawng meigong numei khat zong mu hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: "Maantak kong cihin ah hih mizawng meigongnu in mi khempeuh sangin tam khiazaw hi.
A hang pen tua mite khempeuh in amau' neihval lamval sungpan citpiak sum a khiat uh hi a, meigongnu ahihleh a zawn kawmkal ah a kivakna bup a khia ahi hi."
Tu-in mi kimkhatte biakinnpi thu kikum uh a, suangpek hoihte leh biakpiak vante tawh kizem ahihna a gen uh ciangin Jesu in,
"Hih na muhte uh tawh kisai-in suangtum a kicimlo, khat tungah khat a kithuap lai cih bang a om nawnlo hunte hong tung ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Sya aw, hih thute cik ciang hong piang ding hiam? Hih thute hong tun kuan ciangin kihilna lim bang hiding hiam?" ci-in dong uh hi.

Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: "Note lam hong kipialsak loh nading kidawm un. A hang pen keima' min tawh mi tampi hong pai ding uh a, 'Kei amah ka hi!' hong ci-in, 'A hun hong tung kuanta hi,' hong ci ding uh hi. Tua mite zui kei un.
Tua ciangin galkidona thu leh gam buaina thu na zak uh ciangin lungpatau kei un. A hang pen hih thute hong piang masa hamtang ding a, ahi zongin a beina hong tung pah nailo ding hi."
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Minam khatlekhat, kumpigam khatlekhat kigalbawl ding uh hi.
Nakpi zinling ding a, mun tuamtuam ah kialpi leh pul tung ding hi. Vantung panin a kihtakhuai nate leh kihilna lim lianpite hong kilang ding hi.

Ahih hangin hih teng khempeuh ma-in amaute in note hong manin hong bawlsia ding uh a, vengkhawm innte leh thongte ah hong ap ding uh hi. Note pen keima' min hangin kumpite leh gam-ukte' kiangah hong kitun ding hi.
Tua pen note' adingin teci pan theihna hunpha hong hiding hi.
Tua ahih manin kiphelhzia kigingkhol lo ding ci-in lungsim khensat un.
A hang pen na langte uh khat nangawn in a nan zawhloh ding leh a sel theihloh dingin pilna tawh kikop muklekam kong pia ding hi.
Lawmte, tanaute leh unau sanggamte-a kipan nulehpa-te nangawn in note hong lehhek ding uh a, note' lakah kimkhat sihna hong tun ding uh hi.
Keima' min hangin mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin na samzang uh khat nangawn kisia lo ding hi.
Note in na thuakzawhna uh hangin na nuntakna uh na ngah ding uh hi.
"Ahih hangin galte' uumcih Jerusalem na muh uh ciangin tua khua a siatcip nading nai ta cih thei pah un.
Tua hun ciangin Judea gam sunga om mite mualtungte ah taimang uh hen. Khuapi sunga omte paikhia uh henla, khuata-a omte khuapi sung lut kei uh hen.
A hang pen tu-ate thuhkik hun hi a, a kigelhsa thute khempeuh a tangtun nading ahi hi.
Tua hun sungin numei naupaaite leh nawine naungek neite a dahhuaizia! A hang pen leitung ah lungnopmawhna lianpi om ding a, hih mite' tungah hehna tung ding hi.
Amaute namsau muk tawh si ding uh a, minam citeng lakah matlehen thuakin kikai ding hi. Gentile mite' hun a cin mateng amaute' khe nuai-ah Jerusalem kituancil ding hi.
"Tua ciangin ni leh kha leh aksite ah kihilna limte om ding a, leitung ah tuipi leh tuihual gingte' hangin minamte lungmangin lungnopmawhna om ding hi.
Leitunga hong tung ding thu kihtakna hang leh lauthawngna hangin mite sibup ding uh hi. A hang pen vantunga om vangliante kilok kiling ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite in vangliatna leh minpha vangtaang a lianpi tawh meiilom laka hong pai Mihing' Tapa mu ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, hih thute a pian ding hong kipat ciangin dingto unla khuadak un. A hang pen note' ading tatkhiatna hun a nai hita hi."
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiang thugenteh khat hih bangin gen hi: "Theikung leh singkungte a vekin en dih un.
Tehno hong sel ciangin khuakhal hun naizo ta cih noleno na theitawm uh hi.
Tua mah bangin hih thute a pian na muh uh ciangin Pasian' kumpigam hong nai ta cih thei ta un.
Maantak kong cihin ah tu-a khangmite a bei ma-in hih thu khempeuh piang ding hi.
Vantung leh leitung maimang ding a, ahi zongin ka thugente maimang lo ding hi.
"Ahih hangin kidawmin om un. Hikeileh gualnopna, zukhamna, leitung nuntakvai lunghihmawhna cihte tawh na lungsim uh buaikhop ding a, tua ni zong note' tungah hong tung vat ding hi.
Lei maitang tunga teeng mi khempeuh' tungah hong tung ding a, thangzak kisai vat bang hiding hi.
Ahih hangin a hun simin pilvang tawntung unla, hong piang ding hih thute khempeuh pan suahtak nading tha na neih nadingun leh Mihing' Tapa' mai-ah na dinkhak nadingun thungen un."
Hih bangin Jesu in biakinnpi sungah nisimin thu hilhcian a, zan ciangin Olive a kici mual ah paikhia-in zan hun va zang hi.
Tua ciangin biakinnpi ah ama' thugen ngai dingin mi khempeuh zingsang tuungin ama' kiang hong pai uh hi.Jesu Thah Ding Kisawm
